calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for BigHaat
calls.summary: The team explored GrowthBook to enhance their A/B testing capabilities, as their current system is limited to 1-2 manual experiments and lacks advanced traffic splitting. James Shannon explained GrowthBook's features, emphasizing its open-source, multi-platform support, and integration with data warehouses. Current experiments have shown significant success, with a reported 30% increase in average order value from a single SKU test. The team aims to run 3-4 experiments per month across different user journeys. They reviewed GrowthBook’s pricing tiers, deciding to start with the Professional tier at $40 per user, considering it aligns with their immediate needs and future scaling ambitions.
calls.keywords: A/B Testing, Feature Flags, Statistical Significance, Experimentation, Growth Book, Data Warehouse Integration
